lessons.title: Practice Business Analytics Reporting
lessons.description: Join customers, orders, and products, and report the total spending for each customer. The test checks that you return at least 3 rows and the first customer's total is greater than 1000.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: report each customer's name and total spent (join + group + order by total)
SELECT c.name, 0 AS total_spent FROM customers c WHERE 0 GROUP BY c.name;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

source.name: SQLite official documentation (sqlite.org) — SELECT — joins, GROUP BY and ORDER BY for reporting queries
